property_summary: Once Initialized() has been called, SetMinSum must revert (i.e., cannot change MinSum) for all inputs on the correct contract; the mutant removes this guard so after Initialized() a call to SetMinSum can change MinSum and thus violates the rule.
change_summary: Replace the body to remove the initialization check so SetMinSum always sets MinSum regardless of intitalized, allowing subsequent calls to change MinSum.
